annotation.title_clean: Bozza di linee guida per l’adozione di IA nella pubblica amministrazione
annotation.title_en: Draft Guidelines for the Adoption of AI in Public Administration
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AgID - Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale (with ACN, ANAC, ANCI, Consip, INAIL, INPS, ISTAT and others)
annotation.summary_en: AgID's draft guidelines (v1.0, February 2025, public consultation) for adopting AI in Italian public administration. They set an adoption model covering strategy, risk management, impact assessment, ethical governance, transparency, training, data quality, data protection and cybersecurity, aligned with the EU AI Act. Annexes provide maturity assessment, risk, ethics code template and KPIs.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adoption model for AI in PA: strategy, governance, risk management, impact assessment, operational plan, monitoring.
Risk-based classification of AI systems aligned with the EU AI Act.
Ethical governance and a model code of ethics for public bodies.
Transparency and information duties, plus staff training and skills development.
Data quality, personal data protection and AI cybersecurity (evasion, poisoning, privacy attacks).
